subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should maintainers adopt or port native Telegram album sending now, using the linked fork PR as the starting point, or defer album semantics and keep current sequential multi-media fan-out?
rationale: This is a new visible Telegram channel capability with an open implementation candidate, and repository policy requires maintainer product/owner direction before a separate repair lane supersedes linked contributor work.

options.title: Review or port the linked PR
options.body: Use the existing fork PR as the implementation candidate, then require current-main tests and live Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Defer album semantics
options.body: Keep current sequential media fan-out and leave album grouping unimplemented until maintainers choose the channel behavior.

recommendation.title: Review or port the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing fork PR as the implementation candidate, then require current-main tests and live Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing candidate from current blame, recent Telegram file history, and the prior cleanup review on this issue.
